articleTitle: Research onCross-media Semantic Retrieval in Digital Library Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: A diverse and heterogeneous data environment, an excellent cross-media semantic retrieval model is the key to enhancing the interactivity of digital libraries and promoting the upgrading of their knowledge services. On the basis of analyzing the theoretical concept of deep learning, characteristics of deep structure, related technologies, and correlation between cross-media semantic retrieval and deep learning, this study constructs a cross-media semantic retrieval framework based on deep learning. Research suggests that the combination of deep learning and cross-media semantic retrieval, as a new information retrieval model in digital libraries, helps to solve the problems of searching for semantic information across media and efficiently processing complex dimensional data, greatly improving the efficiency of data retrieval and integration. It will inevitably accelerate improving knowledge service levels in the era of big data. The study provides reference for improving the effectiveness of cross-media semantic retrieval for library users and improving library knowledge organization and services.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning Approach for Multiclass Breast Cancer Detection from Mammogram Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Breast cancer continues to be a significant health concern worldwide, the leading cause of cancer-related deaths among women. However, early detection of breast cancer can significantly enhance survival rates and the efficacy of treatment plans. This study harnesses the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to aid in the accurate and prompt breast cancer diagnosis from histopathological images. We implement a two-stage approach involving image preprocessing using MediCorrectNet, an innovative deep-learning model designed to enhance the diagnostic quality of medical images, and a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for classifying the preprocessed images. Specifically, we utilize the EfficientNetB0 model, a pre-trained network known for its effectiveness in image classification tasks. With the combination of MediCorrectNet and EfficientNetB0, our approach achieved an impressive accuracy of 93%, precision of 92%, recall of 91%, F1-Score of 0.915, and an AUC-ROC of 0.98. These results demonstrate our proposed approach's feasibility and high potential for effective breast cancer diagnosis, setting a promising direction for future research and real-world applications.

articleTitle: Tweets Analysis System for Product Reviews
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Social networking sites are quickly increasing in popularity among internet users due to the increase in technology usage rates. The use of social media may help build real relationships between producers and consumers. This provides a great opportunity for product providers to learn what customers think about their products so that they can better enhance them, better understand their customers and gauge customer inclinations toward their products. In this paper, a machine learning technique is used for sentiment analysis of tweets that contain product reviews. Snscrape was applied to collect tweets. Support vector machine was used for sentiment analysis classification, achieving an impressive 95% accuracy.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based Implementation of Enhanced ZUC Stream Cipher Based on Dynamic S-Box
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: ZUC algorithm is a word-oriented stream cipher designed by the Data Assurance and Communication Security Research Center of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and standardized by the 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project) organization to ensure the LTE (Long Term Evolution of radio networks) security and 5G (the fifth generation of cellular network technology). However, many studies in the literature have proven that the ZUC algorithm has certain weaknesses. The objective of this study is, improve the security of the ZUC algorithm, implement the improved version on an FPGA board, and then evaluate its performance. The design improvement is to replace the static S-boxes of the ZUC algorithm by a Dynamic S-box, which allows to generate a new keystream with each new execution of the algorithm and this by flipping just one bit in the initial values. We thus obtain the best robustness against cryptographic attacks. The new S-box, initialized by 256 ordered values [0,1,…,255] is permuted using the 2-D cat map. The parameters (u, v ri, rj) of the cat map (dynamic permutation key, Kp) are supplied by the feedback value of the LSFR at the end of the initialization phase. The system is implemented on a Xilinx XC7Z020 PYNQ-Z2 FPGA platform and its robustness is evaluated using many security tests. The use of a dynamic S-box surely increases the security against cryptanalytic attacks of the algorithm, compared to the use of a static S-box. Moreover, the proposed algorithm is robust against the main statistical attacks. It achieves acceptable hardware performance for use in real-time applications.

articleTitle: Novel Machine Learning Approach for High-Precision Brain Tumor Detection from MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: In the ever-evolving medical imaging landscape, the accurate diagnosis of brain tumors presents formidable challenges. Our study introduces a groundbreaking approach harnessing the formidable capabilities of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) in tandem with an attention mechanism, significantly elevating the efficacy of brain tumor detection from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. This innovative attention-based CNN model prioritizes crucial features within MRI scans and substantially enhances overall diagnostic accuracy. Through rigorous training and validation on a diverse Kaggle dataset encompassing four distinct tumor types, glioma, meningioma, pituitary, and no tumor, we have achieved a remarkable overall accuracy rate of 94%, firmly establishing the model's effectiveness. Notably, the precision, recall, and F1-score metrics for each tumor category further validate our methodology's robustness, exemplified by a remarkable F1-score of 0.97 in identifying ‘No Tumor’ cases. This study pioneers a fresh perspective in integrating machine learning into medical imaging. It underscores the potential of attention-driven CNNs as powerful tools for precise and early brain tumor diagnosis. Our results spotlight the model's exceptional balance between sensitivity and specificity, positioning it as an invaluable asset in brain tumor detection.

articleTitle: A Study of Human-Computer Interaction to Engage the Customers in the Context of Social Media Marketing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: In modern era every brand tries to engage its customer with the use of modern tools like social media. Social media is cost effective and instant tool to convey message to the customers. Keeping in view the importance of social media in modern marketing the aim of this study to explore the antecedents which are helpful of customer engagement with the brand. Survey method was used to collect the data from targeted population. Results of the study show that different antecedents such as customer involvement, customer participation and self-expressive brand has positive and significant association with customer satisfaction. Moreover, customer satisfaction has positive relationship with customer loyalty. The results of this study will be helpful for the brands that how can they engage their customer and develop long term customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Preliminary Evaluation of Flexible Screen-Printed Resistive Voltage Divider
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Voltage dividers are critical passive circuit elements employed with the aim of adjusting the amplitude of a signal, for biasing of active devices in amplifiers, and for performing voltage measurements. The emergence of flexible electronics is requesting for development of various types of printed passive electrical circuits for ensuring transition from hybrid electronics to fully printed devices. Thus, within the herein paper we are presenting the procedure of manufacturing a linear voltage divider, screen-printed at the level of a polymeric substrate. The flexible voltage divider is demonstrating its operability in respect to both AC and DC current and good accuracy at different signal amplitudes.

articleTitle: Mobile Integration for Sakai LMS and Class Schedule Platform at an Higher Education Institution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: In the age of mobile technology, the demand for seamless access to educational resources has become essential. This work presents a project the integration of a Learning Management System (LMS) and a class schedule platform of a higher education institution, developing for that a mobile application aimed at integrating with the LMS used at the institution. The application seeks to enhance the learning experience by providing students, instructors, and administrators with anytime, anywhere access to the LMS core functionalities. The proposed mobile application will serve as a comprehensive extension to the LMS, extending its capabilities to mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets. The development process was done with continuous feedback from educators and students, with different testing and quality assurance measures implemented to ensure the security, reliability, and performance.

articleTitle: Comparison Between GA and PSO Optimized PID and PSS for SMIB System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: We discuss in this paper the use of genetic algorithms (GA) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) techniques to optimize the parameters of the power system stabilizer (PSS) and proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controllers for a single-machine infinite-bus bar (SMIB) system. These optimization methods are of interest due to their ability to solve complex engineering problems and improve the stability and efficiency of electrical systems. The aim of this study is to compare the performance of GA and PSO in optimizing the parameters of the PSS and PID controllers for the SMIB system. By evaluating the performance metrics such as load angle and rotor speed variations, we seek to determine the effectiveness of each optimization technique in achieving the desired stability and efficiency. The simulation results indicate the importance of carefully selecting the optimization method when optimizing the parameters of the PSS and PID controllers. We found that what may be suitable for the PSS controller in terms of optimization method may not necessarily be suitable for the PID controller. Hence, a judicious choice of the optimization method is crucial to achieve optimal performance.

articleTitle: Acceleration of Complex Matrix Multiplication Using Arbitrary Precision Floating-Point Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Efficient multiple precision linear numerical computation libraries such as MPLAPACK are critical in dealing with ill-conditioned problems. Specifically, there are optimization methods for matrix multiplication, such as the Strassen algorithm and the Ozaki scheme, which can be used to speed up computation. For complex matrix multiplication, the 3M method can also be used, which requires only three multiplications of real matrices, instead of the 4M method, which requires four multiplications of real matrices. In this study, we extend these optimization methods to arbitrary precision complex matrix multiplication and verify the possible increase in computation speed through benchmark tests. The optimization methods are also applied to complex LU decomposition using matrix multiplication to demonstrate that the Ozaki scheme can be used to achieve higher computation speeds.

articleTitle: Detection Based Crop Segmentation Using NDVI in UAV Multispectral Image Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Recently, there has been extensive research on agricultural building data and smart agriculture. Semantic segmentation is employed as a fundamental task to obtain continuous growth information of specific crops. Currently, various state-of-the-art methods are applied to semantic segmentation, and research is being conducted to improve performance, but depending on the number and characteristics of the data, there are still cases where high performance is not achieved. If multispectral data can be used to identify the shape of a crop, it is efficient to detect the location of the object first in terms of speed and accuracy. By dividing the crop and background regions through detection and extracting the shape of the crop from the crop region, a semantic segmentation map for the crop can be obtained. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a segmentation method using detection based NDVI and presents the UAV multispectral image data built to perform the segmentation process. To validate the built data, a detection model was trained, whereby an average precision of 0.984 was attained.

articleTitle: RFT Based Efficient Broadband Chebyshev Filter Design of (K and Ka) Range
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: A stepped impedance bandpass Chebyshev filter design covers the K and Ka bands which includes three of 5G RF2 bands n257, n258, and n261 via real frequency technique (RFT) is studied, synthesized and simulated in this work. RFT is a complex math work, for that reason MATLAB employed for generating polynomials needed for this technique, ADS utilized for designing and simulating the BP-filter for verifying the resulted gain of the circuit. The characteristics of the filter listed in details in this paper, the characteristics of the final design after optimization are fl, f2 are 22.22, and 29.5 GHz respectively, Insertion Loss (IL) is set as 0.5dB. The achieved attenuation reached -55, the initial and final number of order before and after the optimization are n=3 and n=8 respectively. RFT technique yielded an accurate synthesized values, small size, and sharp slop.

articleTitle: Design a Wideband Class-J Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This paper presents the modern design and simulation of a broadband Class-J power amplifier (CJPA) tailored for enhancing military radar systems, especially those operating in the critical L-band spectrum. Motivated by the need for improved radar performance, our research aims to achieve higher efficiency and power output through the meticulous application of load pull and source pull techniques in the input and output matching circuit design to obtain the input and output impedance for active device at maximum power to match them with 50 Ω by design matching circuits using Smith chat utility. This study utilizes the GaN HEMT CGH40025F and focuses on designing and simulating a CJPA operating in the 1.6 to 2 GHz frequency range for the L-band. The test results demonstrate that the CJPA outputs around 40 dBm when the input power is 24 dBm, with a notable power added efficiency (PAE) of 63% and a transducer gain of 16 dB within the band. The simulation and testing were conducted using the Keysight ADS software. The significance of these findings lies in the enhanced capabilities they bring to military radar systems, with the potential for improved target detection, tracking, and overall system performance. Moreover, the optimized CJPA design may find applications beyond military settings, contributing to advancements in RF amplifier technology for diverse communication and sensing systems.

articleTitle: Wind Speed Prediction Using a SEEMD-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Although wind energy appears to be a very promising replacement for fossil fuel energy, it faces some challenges during implementation. Producing precise predictions for wind energy is of utmost significance in energy strategic planning. This is because wind data is non-stationary and non-linear in nature; therefore, common statistical and computational methods cannot produce adequate predictions for wind. In this study, we utilized a hybrid method that combines a variation of Empirical Mode Decomposition, Smoothing Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (SEEMD), and long-short-term memory neural networks (LSTM) to predict wind speed. The results of this study provide a promising forecasting method for predicting non-stationary and non-linear phenomena such as wind. The hybrid method proposed in this study successfully predicted the wind-speed data with an R2 value of 0.9353 a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.0504 as well as the wind-direction data with an R2 value of 0.9711 and a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.1626.

articleTitle: Evaluation method and input selection for the model to predict the maximum and minimum ambient temperature parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: The input selection is a very important step in the process of building the model for identification, control or prediction,… A good set of input will ensure a compact model with acceptable accuracy. This paper develops a method based on linear decomposition of output signal into input signals to evaluate, compare and select the input for the forecasting model. The experimental results are compared with other methods such as the correlation-based selection, the Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Linear Discriminat Analysis method (LDA). Experimental results show that with the problem of selecting input parameters for the problem of predicting the maximum and minimum temperature in Hai Duong, the method of expanding linear components (SVD) gives better results. The main content of the article: (i) presents an overview of input feature extraction methods; (ii) common methods of selecting input characteristics for predictive models; (iii) simulation results and discussion; (iv) conclusion.

articleTitle: Optimizing Solar-Powered Electric Vehicle Management with Distributed Decision Making Under Shading Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Solar-powered electric vehicles (SEVs) have gained significant importance in the future of sustainable transportation due to their positive environmental impact and the increasing cost of fuel. However, a major limitation of SEVs is that photovoltaic (PV) panels supply less power than required to propel the vehicle, necessitating the use of energy storage systems. This situation presents several challenges, including shading obstacles in urban areas, driver and road safety concerns, the need to differentiate between shiftable and non-shiftable loads based on current conditions, and maximizing the lifetime of the storage system. To address these issues, this paper proposes a distributed energy management approach that incorporates four parallel functions: frequency separation, reduction, prediction, and shedding. Each function can operate independently, providing greater flexibility. The effectiveness and high performance of this proposed strategy were demonstrated through simulations conducted using Matlab software. To validate the efficacy of the approach, experimental results were achieved using the hardware-in-the-loop testing.

articleTitle: A Comparative Review of Multimodal Fusion Techniques for Medical Image Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Medical image fusion involves combining multiple images captured using different imaging techniques into a single, highly informative image, thereby enhancing the utility of medical images in clinical settings. This article presents a brief overview of multimodal medical image fusion technology, specifically focusing on recent advances in the field. These advancements build upon existing fusion methods and tools, including deep learning-based fusion technologies, medical image fusion imaging techniques, and medical image fusion performance evaluation using large datasets. Despite facing several challenges, contemporary multimodal medical image fusion research has made significant strides, as underscored by the findings in this report.

articleTitle: Forward Kinematic Analysis of a Pick-and-Place Robot for Industrial Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Pick and place robots are used in many industrial applications, i.e. packaging, bin picking and inspection. They are available in different joint configurations, depending upon the nature of the application in which they are used. Some of the configurations of the pick and place robots are revolute-revolute-prismatic, revolute-revolute-revolute-prismatic etc. In pick and place robotic systems, tracking the end-effector's location is as crucial as it is in any robotic mechanism. Ensuring the accurate positioning of the end-effector is vital for the successful transfer of items from one point to another. In the current study, a revolute-prismatic-prismatic pick and place robot is studied. The primary aim of this research is to examine the forward kinematics of the prototype pick and place robotic system. The forward kinematics of the pick and place robot was studied using geometrical method, DH parameter method and ANSYS rigid dynamics tool. The algebraic equations were formulated using the geometrical method. In addition, the homogenous transformation matrix was formulated using DH parameter method. Then, the prototype of the pick and place robot was modeled in design modeler, an ANSYS built in CAD module. The pick and place prototype model was then analyzed using ANSYS rigid dynamics module. Three cases were considered for pick and place robot, with different parameters. The results were then calculated using the three methods, i.e. geometrical, DH parameter, and ANSYS rigid dynamic module. The results of the forward kinematics of the prototype pick and place robot obtained from three methods, are found to be in close agreement with each other.

articleTitle: Subjective QoE Evaluation of 8K VVC Videos Under Various Viewing Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Quality of experience (QoE) is an important measure for determining the level of user satisfaction with a service, and the exploration of specific factors that affect QoE is necessary. We conducted a subjective QoE evaluation experiment for 8K broadcasting by incorporating 8K video characteristics, namely the sense of reality (RE) and sense of presence (PR), as influence factors. Several compressed 8K videos were evaluated for various screen sizes and viewing distances considering a practical use case. The participants answered four questions relating to the video quality (VQ), RE, PR, and QoE for each test video. We analyzed the experimental results and investigated the relationship between the QoE and other factors (VQ, RE, and PR) under various viewing conditions. The results suggest that 1) multiple factors affect the QoE and 2) the factors are not always positively correlated, even if a factor has a positive meaning (e.g., RE and PR).

articleTitle: A Semi-Supervised Approach for Multi-Domain Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This research paper presents an innovative approach for addressing the classification of data originating from multiple domains when there is a scarcity of labeled data. While current data technologies have achieved impressive accuracy in single-domain classification, the challenge of multi-domain classification persists due to contextual variations. To tackle this issue, we introduce a multi-task based unsupervised data augmentation (UDA) approach that enables learning of domain-specific data contexts. UDA is widely recognized as one of the most effective semi-supervised frameworks, as it requires only a small amount of labeled data for learning purposes. In our study, we leverage a BERT language model and train it using our proposed approach to acquire domain-aware embeddings for data assessment. By doing so, we enhance the ability to classify data from various domains accurately.

articleTitle: Performance of Fiber Optic Sensors Based on Waist Enlarged Tapers for Solubility of Naringin in Water
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: The concentration of naringin in food is crucial for various purposes, such as controlling bitterness, maintaining quality, promoting health benefits, optimizing formulation, and ensuring regulatory compliance. By utilizing fiber optic sensors, we can accurately measure the solubility of naringin in water, contributing to the improvement of naringin-related processes and applications. The objective of this project is to design and fabricate Single mode-Multimode-Single mode (SMS) and Multimode-Single mode-Multimode (MSM) sensors with waist enlarged tapers. The performance of both sensors on the solubility of naringin in water was analyzed. To achieve this objective, two sensor structures were developed using the Commercial Splicer Fujikura FSM 18-R, based on the Mach Zehnder Interferometer (MZI) concept. The structures had different overlap distances ranging from 30 µm to 150 µm. To measure the sensitivity of the sensors, eight different concentrations of naringin solution have been tested. By doing this, we will be able to ascertain the water solubility of naringin. It can be observed that the higher overlap distance improves the sensitivity of the sensor. Meanwhile, the MSM sensor exhibits superior performance than SMS sensor of the waist enlarged tapers. The results of the experiment showed that the MSM sensor with a 150 µm overlap distance had the highest sensitivity, measuring 752.81 nW/RIU.

articleTitle: Wideband Chebyshev Bandpass Filter via RFT for RF2 (Ka and V) Bands and Communication Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: In this paper a wideband Chebyshev bandpass filter BPF is presented, the passband filter covers Ka and V bands which covers two bands of FR2 of the fifth generation <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5\mathrm{G}$</tex> bands n260 = 37-40GHz, and n259 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$=39.5-43.5$</tex> GHz with the utilization of the mathematical topology of Real frequency technique RFT, most specifically the parametric approach RFT is utilized where the lossless equalizer is described by its minimum driving point immittance function FQ(p). Characteristics of our microstrip stepped impedance design are f1 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$=37$</tex> GHz, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{f}2=43$</tex> GHz, where we achieved great results in terms of ripple loss was less than 0.5, and the insertion loss -96 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{dB}$</tex> with sharp slop as well as small size. The parameters were calculated using MATLAB due to the complexity of the technique that has been used. Advanced design system ADS has been utilized to optimize and simulate the results.

articleTitle: Development and Optimization of Screw Bodied Design for Burrowing Robotic Applications in Loose Sand
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This research article studies the effects of screw design parameters namely, pitch, height, and diameter on the torque requirements for burrowing in loose sand. Field test data was collected through series of experiments conducted in the sand dunes of the western region of Saudi Arabia. The study analyzed nine different screw shells; each designed with distinct variations in these parameters. These experiments seek to elucidate the relationship between design parameters and the torque needed to achieve certain depths in loose sand. By investigating the behavior of these screw designs, this study contributes to the understanding of optimal configurations of screw body for digging with minimal torque requirement. The findings indicate that specific combinations of pitch, height, and diameter yield superior performance, shedding light on crucial factors for designing effective burrowing mechanisms. Among the tested shells it was found that the ideal design parameters are 37mm pitch, 125mm height, and 75mm diameter which draw a torque of 5 N.m at 50 cm depth. This work paves the way for advancements in self-burrowing robot technology, providing insights that will aid in body design and information to be used for motor selection and electronics sizing.

articleTitle: BA-TMS: Design and Implementation of Blockchain Based Aggregate Transportation Management System Using Smart Order and Electronic Invoice
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: In recent years, blockchain technology has emerged as a force of transformation that confuses traditional industries due to its decentralized and transparent nature. Originally developed to support cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, the blockchain has since evolved into a multi-purpose platform far beyond the realm of digital currencies. Blockchain has attracted attention in a variety of areas, including finance, healthcare, and logistics, with its potential to innovate supply chains, enhance data security, and streamline transactions. The construction industry is one of the cornerstones of global economic growth and plays a pivotal role in shaping the physical environment in which we live. However, despite remarkable developments in various fields due to technological innovation, construction has been recognized as somewhat resistant to change. Traditional practices that often rely on paper-based documents and numerous intermediaries continued, leading to issues of transparency, efficiency and accountability. This domestic construction industry itself has a unique conservative cultural character, making digital transformation slower. In order to ensure the reliability of data generated in the manufacturing process of washed aggregate among building materials, this paper attempted to ensure the reliability of data by introducing blockchain techniques. In addition, in the product delivery stage, the accuracy in the order and delivery stage was improved by introducing unmanned shipments and electronic document systems through mobile smart orders. As such, the data collected in real time in this system provides integrity for the aggregate delivery system. By combining these functions, we would like to conduct a study on the aggregate transportation management system (BA-TMS).

articleTitle: Stabilized Platform Control Unit Modelling and Control for Drilling Rotary Steerable System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: A Permanent Magnetic Synchronous Motor (PMSM) is integrated within stabilized platform of Rotary Steerable System (RSS) drilling drive. By controlling the parameters of servo drive we can actively adjust position and orientation of drilling bit in real-time, responding to the drilling conditions and maintaining stability. The stabilized platform control unit designed with PI controller by using back calculation anti windup control technique. A closed loop structure is proposed to control the angular speed and current of PMSM. By controlling these parameters the anticipated stabilization of the platform achieved and overall drilling process performance enhanced with prime accuracy. These findings demonstrate the method's efficiency in rejecting instabilities. Numerical simulation verified the proposed control structure.

articleTitle: Eyegaze Control Algorithm Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Every year, most people lose a body part due to various types of accidents, which causes them to become disabled and unable to perform various activities on their own. Typically, disabled people require assistance in moving from one position to another so that they can work. Most people have numerous skills but are unable to perform any of them due to disability. There are a lot of people who are depressed because of their disability and have been fighting to get out of it for a long time. There should be some kind of solution for these disabled people, and Eye gaze Movement as a Remote is essentially providing a way to control. Eye tracking tells us where we look, what we ignore, and how the pupil reacts to different stimuli. The concept of eye tracking is simple, but the process and interpretation can be very diverse and complex. The goal of this project is to remove disabilities so that people can perform their tasks like normal people, and eye gaze is a way for disabled people to perform different tasks using their eyes movement. This report investigates a novel technique for pupil recognition. Image processing stages such as pre-processing, face recognition, and feature extraction are all involved. Finally, this eye detection system will be implemented and written in the “Python” programming language. This data can be analyzed, visualized, and interpreted. To increase the likelihood of success with this concept, we have integrated our software with a robotics car and moved it using these movements and interactions

articleTitle: SRSS: A New Chaos-Based Single-Round Single S-Box Image Encryption Scheme for Highly Auto-Correlated Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: With the advent of digital communication, securing digital images during transmission and storage has become a critical concern. The traditional s-box substitution methods often fail to effectively conceal the information within highly auto-correlated regions of an image. This paper addresses the security issues presented by three prevalent S-box substitution methods, i.e., single S-box, multiple S-boxes, and multiple rounds with multiple S-boxes, especially when handling images with highly auto-correlated pixels. To resolve the addressed security issues, this paper proposes a new scheme SRSS-the Single Round Single S-Box encryption scheme. SRSS uses a single S-box for substitution in just one round to break the pixel correlations and encrypt the plaintext image effectively. Additionally, this paper introduces a new Chaos-based Random Operation Selection System-CROSS, which nullifies the requirement for multiple S-boxes, thus reducing the encryption scheme's complexity. By randomly selecting the operation to be performed on each pixel, driven by a chaotic sequence, the proposed scheme effectively scrambles even high auto-correlation areas. When compared to the substitution methods mentioned above, the proposed encryption scheme exhibited exceptionally well in just a single round with a single S-box. The close-to-ideal statistical security analysis results, i.e., an entropy of 7.89 and a correlation coefficient of 0.007, validate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme. This research offers an innovative path forward for securing images in applications requiring low computational complexity and fast encryption and decryption speeds.

articleTitle: Double Visual Cryptography Using Generalized Tent Map, Rotation, and Image Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This paper introduces a Multi-Visual Cryptography (MVC) system for sharing two color images, where the secrets can be revealed with low computation power using all the shares. The system uses the generalized Tent map as a source of randomness to generate any number of random shares. More specifically, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(n-1)$</tex> random shares are generated, and then, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n^{th}$</tex> share is calculated from the random shares and the secrets using rotations of the shares. In recovery, rotation of the last share recovers the two images based on the angle of rotation. Half the number of pixels is recovered for each secret image, whereas a modified weighted average filter is used to improve the quality of the recovered images significantly. The system does not use halftone images and produces shares of the same size as the secrets without pixel expansion or auxiliary data. The proposed system is efficient, passed several security tests, and is compared to recent works.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-Band Bandpass Filter for Effective Filtering in a Next-Generation Handheld Wireless Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This paper presents the design and characterization of a dual-band bandpass filter (BPF) that utilizes multiple open and short-circuit stubs. The filter's center frequency and bandwidth of both passbands can be adjusted by controlling the length and width of the stubs. The proposed BPF operates at two center frequencies of 2.4 and 6.2 GHz, respectively. The proposed design yields five transmission poles and zeros in two passbands with fractional bandwidths (FBW) of 40% and 24.6%, respectively. The filter's minimum insertion loss is 0.5 dB, and the maximum return loss is 13.9 dB. Moreover, the proposed BPF design offers a remarkable out-of-band suppression of 37.8 dB in the upper stopband region of 6 GHz, making it ideal for various wireless communication applications. To validate the filter's response, a prototype has been fabricated, and the measured and full-wave electromagnetic simulation results are well-matched.

articleTitle: Studying the Influential Factors for Intention to Use Social Networking Sites
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Social media presents a cost-effective and instantaneous avenue to relay messages to customers. Recognizing the significance of social media in modern marketing, the primary objective of this study is to delve into the determinants influencing customer intentions to utilize social media. Employing a survey methodology, data were collected from the targeted population. Findings from this study reveal that various factors, including social media literacy, perceived behavioral control, and perceived risk, exhibit positive and significant correlations with users' attitudes. Furthermore, a positive linkage was observed between users' attitudes and their intention to engage with social media. The insights gleaned from this study hold the potential to guide social media platforms in devising strategies that resonate with individuals, aiding them in effectively attracting and retaining users on their platforms.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Double-Sided LC Network for Wireless Capacitive Transcutaneous Energy Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation analysis of load and coupling variations for a current Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) technique, known as Capacitive Power Transfer (CPT). Due to its strength, CPT becomes an effective and essential alternative to conservative technique, which is Inductive Power Transfer (IPT). It can compete IPT in industrial demand since it has a small number of component usage, uncomplicated topology, increases electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding performance and robust to surrounding metallic elements. Class E power amplifier with the presence of LC network circuit is applied in this work as a high frequency ac power source since it has the ability to perform dc-to-ac inversion efficiently. It supports the CPT system to attain a maximum power transmission. MATLAB software is used to design and simulate the proposed CPT circuit; and the analysis is made up from the results. This proposed system able to generate 1W of output power by maintaining up to 98% efficiency at 6.78MHz operating frequency for Biomedical Implantable Device application. The analysis of load variation is in the range of 50Ω until 1kΩ; meanwhile for coupling variation is between 1mm to 15mm.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Photovoltaic System Interfacing Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: In this work, we proceeded to study a photovoltaic solar generator connected to the distribution network and participated in the improvement of the quality of energy injected into the grid. Operation with a unity power factor is obtained by controlling the photovoltaic active power injected. The two-stage system is structured around a photovoltaic generator, a boost chopper, and a three-phase voltage inverter. To optimize the energy extracted from the photovoltaic generator, a global P&O type maximum power extraction technique is associated with the control in order to generate the optimal reference voltage on the DC bus. The results of the simulation allowed us to visualize the operation of the various components of the system, as well as the behavior of the system during the variation of the meteorological values.

articleTitle: A Real-time Data Analysis Approach for Predicting COVID-19 Outcomes using Heterogeneous Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: COVID-19, caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, has resulted in over 5.3 million deaths worldwide, significantly impacting global demographics and causing severe acute respiratory syndrome. This study presents a novel approach to predicting COVID-19 outcomes using a heterogeneous ensemble learning methodology. By combining multiple machine learning models trained on different portions of the data, the approach aims to create a more accurate and robust prediction model. The study utilizes various classifiers, including K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, and Artificial Neural Network (ANN). Individual accuracies for these models range from 74.58% to 82.29%. By employing the effective majority voting method of heterogeneous ensemble learning, an impressive overall accuracy of 82.29% is achieved. The findings indicate that this approach outperforms standalone models and other ensemble techniques in predicting COVID-19 outcomes, making it a valuable tool for healthcare decision-makers. The proposed strategy has significant policy implications for managing and detection of critical COVID-19 patients with limited provided attributes.

articleTitle: Design Continues Mode Inverse Class-F Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This paper outlines the design, simulation, and testing of a continuous mode inverse class-F (CMICF) power amplifier (PA) specifically optimized for GSM applications. The comprehensive design methodology encompasses DC analysis, optimum load impedance calculation, stability circuit analysis, and input and output matching circuit design. The amplifier is built using Gallium Nitride (GaN) High Electron Mobility Transistor (HEMT), and it introduces a novel technique for designing the output matching network (OMN). This technique involves extracting parasitic elements from the power device using a tuning method and employs a graphical approach with the Smith chart utility to obtain the second and third harmonics of the output signal. The resulting design achieves high efficiency with a reduced component count, simplifying the overall design process and reducing costs. The design work was facilitated using Keysight ADS software. Operating in the frequency range of 1.5 GHz to 2 GHz, the amplifier demonstrates a maximum output power of approximately 40 dBm and a power gain of 16 dB, with a power-added efficiency exceeding 70%.

articleTitle: Designing an Affordable Open-Source Automated Warehouse Control Center
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Companies are grappling with difficulties in recruiting manual laborers for various reasons, with warehouse-operating businesses being among the hardest hit. The objective is to demonstrate a viable Affordable Open-Source Automated Warehouse Control Center that enables small businesses to enhance and automate their warehouse ‘picking’ operations through Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs). Exclusively free and open-source software tools are employed. The successfully tested proof of concept encompasses a web app, an SQL Server relational database, and AMRs powered by ROS. This showcases that with the use of free and open-source resources, it's feasible to develop a system that aids companies in addressing the labor shortage

articleTitle: An Optimal VR-Game Content Control Strategy based on User Physiological Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative virtual reality game control method to improve existing game content control approaches, aiming to provide a gaming experience that combines maximum entertainment and safety through automated control techniques. Firstly, the game system presented in this paper collects players' physiological and psychological information through wearable devices, and then obtains the players' physical and mental states via trained CNN. The system will automatically adjust the game content based on the players' states, including game difficulty, scenes, and interactive modes of game characters, to deliver the most suitable content output to the players. To validate the effectiveness of this control system, the paper conducts questionnaire feedback to assess the performance and user experience of this novel game control method. The experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in gaming experience, including higher immersion and entertainment, using this user perception-based automated control method. At the same time, it also ensures game safety by preventing potential or significant harm to users due to excessive stimulation during gameplay. Therefore, our research findings have important reference value and practicality for virtual reality game developers and researchers in related fields.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Low-g MEMS Accelerometer Utilizing Weakly Coupled Resonators
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: The primary focus of this paper is to design a mode-localized MEMS accelerometer that incorporates weakly coupled resonators of 2-DoF. This accelerometer's proof-mass is designed to form an electrostatic coupling with the inner resonator of the 2-DoF weakly coupled resonators. The acceleration sensed by this device is measured by using the ratios between the amplitudes of vibrations in both resonators. A comprehensive analysis is performed which incorporates both simulations based on FEM (finite element method) and analytical calculations. This approach allows for a thorough understanding of the device's behavior and characteristics. The limitations and constraints of the widely available microfabrication technique, SOIMUMPS (silicon-on-insulator multi-user MEMS processes) are also considered while designing this accelerometer. Overall, this paper presents a comprehensive overview of the design process, performance analysis, and fabrication readiness of the 2-DoF mode-localization-based MEMS accelerometer. The sensitivity reported for this accelerometer is 6.94/g, considering the ratio of the vibrational amplitudes as the output metric. The findings demonstrate the potential of this design to meet the stringent requirements of various applications, particularly those requiring precise motion-sensing capabilities.

articleTitle: Design of an Energy-Efficient Parity Function Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce an energy-efficient parity function circuit that is implemented using XOR (exclusive-OR) and XNOR (exclusive-NOR) circuits. The proposed circuit reduces the internal load capacitance on the critical path and is designed with only 8 transistors. The circuit produces perfect output signals for all input combinations. The proposed parity function circuit demonstrates a 6.4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> reduction in average propagation delay time, a 29.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> decrease in power dissipation, a 36.6% decrease in power-delay product (PDP), a 43.0% decrease in energy-delay product (EDP), and a 55.6% decrease in energy-delay-delay product (EDDP), respectively. Compared with the previous circuits, the proposed circuit exhibits the improved characteristics in terms of average propagation delay time, power dissipation, PDP, EDP, and EEDP. The proposed circuits are implemented with standard CMOS 0.18um technology. Computer simulations using SPICE show that the proposed circuit performs the expected logic functions and achieves a reasonable performance.

articleTitle: Beacons at University Campus, a Mobile Application to Improve Learning and Bridge Diversity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: When people move int its quotidian, it is important to them to receive some customized place information. Nowadays it has been difficult to work in things like advertising, notifying, indicating, tracking and many other. The purpose of this project is to implement a solution that allows the sending of information (personalized notifications) to the user, when he approaches different campus locations, using BLE devices known as beacons. To achieve this, a mobile application was developed, that helps user to access and receive information, additionally a web application has been developed for the management operations and its related things. Taking advantage of Beacon technology, we develop an application to notify interest information to the user. We have collected the information of different types of beacons and analyzed them, which will help us while configuring and developing application which will meet the objective we intended. This project represents a groundbreaking initiative in leveraging mobile technology to bridge diversity gaps and promote inclusivity within university campuses. By facilitating meaningful connections, encouraging cultural exchange, and providing resources for understanding, this innovative mobile application seeks to create an environment where all members of the campus community feel valued, respected, and empowered.

articleTitle: Platform for Optimizing Photovoltaic Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This project aims to support the development and optimization of Intelligent Environments by simulating and analyzing user behaviors within these environments. Intelligent Environments leverage technology and artificial intelligence to enhance human experiences, requiring Today, we live in a world where it is essential to have all the necessary information available at the right time and in the right place. Applications, associated with different devices such as smartphones and computers, have brought this information into our hands. In that way, this project aims to develop a platform for maximizing photovoltaic use, which helps to improve energy consumption through photovoltaic panels. The platform will manage a heat pump considering the energy generated by the photovoltaic panels, control consumption and see the current temperature. The project have used two technologies known in the field of home automation, namely node-red and mqtt, which will facilitate the connection, in order to control and obtain information from the devices. The platform will control the heat pump through the mqtt protocol using node-red. Using the application home assistant we show several graphs with information on energy consumption, heat pump temperature, the outside temperature and other information.

articleTitle: Parabolic Reflector Antenna Design to Generate Pure High Order Vortex Modes at 24 GHz
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Parabolic reflector (PR) antennas are commercially applied to the two Wi-Fi frequencies of 2.4 and 5 GHz in this conference paper. For the generation of vortex waves, a high gain and directive antenna structure is proposed here with PR. It is a unique feature of electromagnetic (EM) waves to have vortex or orbital angular momentum (OAM). OAM technique (known as conical pattern with twisted phase plane) can theoretically increase radio frequency links' capacity and diversity with infinite characteristic mode numbers. On the other hand, it is challenging to implement it in practice due to divergence of pattern and reception quality and capability. Therefore, the PR structure can be considered a promising method to improve the vortex feature of a signal at the generation section. For a long-range dense link, a PR antenna at 24 GHz is designed to address issues related to high order vortex modes (mode 6). This frequency spectrum and other higher frequencies are used to increase the capacity of the backhaul network.

articleTitle: Application of Convolutional Neural Networks for Automated Diabetic Retinopathy Detection from Retinal Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a debilitating consequence of diabetes that leads to blindness if not diagnosed in its early stages. With the surge of deep learning methodologies, automatic detection of DR has become a highly researched area with promising results. This study presents a comprehensive approach to detect DR employing a tailored Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model on retinal fundus images. Our proposed model follows a sequential pattern comprising multiple layers for feature extraction and classification. Each convolutional layer utilizes learnable filters to recognize significant patterns and enhance feature representation through non-linear activation functions such as ReLU. The architecture also incorporates pooling layers to reduce spatial dimensions, thereby improving computational efficiency and fully connected layers to integrate learned features. The output layer, fitted with a softmax activation function, consists of neurons equivalent to the number of target classes for DR detection: normal, mild, moderate, severe, and proliferative DR. Our model's weights and biases are optimized using the Adam algorithm during training. This research provides a robust model for automated and accurate detection of DR stages, aiming to augment ophthalmic healthcare services, especially in regions with scarce expert resources. Preliminary results demonstrate the effectiveness of our model, achieving competitive performance on the benchmark dataset. Further, our study paves the way for more advanced research in automated DR diagnosis using deep learning methodologies.

Author Keywords: Medical image fusion, Convolutional neural network Non-subsampled, Pooling

articleTitle: Diagnosing Faults in Smart Grids using Liquid Time-Constant Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: The adoption of smart grids (SGs) has become increasingly popular due to their ability to deliver automated and decentralized energy distribution to consumers. However, in order to ensure the reliable and secure provision of high-quality power from generation sources to end-users, SGs are required to be equipped with efficient diagnostic systems. This paper introduces an effective data-driven approach for diagnosing faults and failures in SGs. In particular, it is proposed to employ Liquid Time-Constant networks for the sake of diagnosing faults in an experimental power transmission system. To evaluate and verify the effectiveness of the proposed diagnostic scheme, a comprehensive study is conducted on a Three-Bus Two-Line experimental setup. Different scenarios by considering various types of faults and failures have been simulated in this case study, and the attained results verify the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Self-Modulated Feature Fusion GAN for Text-to-Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Text-to-image synthesis is one of the key tasks in the cross-modal generation, which aims to generate natural and realistic images under the condition of text description. The main challenge of this task is how to efficiently integrate text information into the process of image synthesis while satisfying a high degree of semantic consistency. Existing methods based on generative adversarial networks(GANs) use stacked network structures (2–3 groups of generators and discriminators) to generate high-resolution images in stages and add text information at different stages of generation. Most aforementioned methods may give rise to some issues such as generator interdependence and an unwarranted proliferation of network parameters. To address these limitations, we propose a generative adversarial network architecture with a single generator and discriminator. The Adaptive Semantic Image feature Fusion module in the generator can effectively compensate for the lack of fine-grained information caused by a single generator and discriminator. In addition, to stabilize the network training and enhance the semantic consistency between the text and the synthesized image, local spectral normalization is used in the discriminator, and contrastive loss is added to enhance the discriminator's ability to supervise the synthesis of the generator. Extensive experiments on CUB and COCO datasets demonstrate that the proposed model is superior to the existing models.

articleTitle: Noise-Crypt: Image Encryption with Non-linear Noise, Hybrid Chaotic Maps, and Hashing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: To secure the digital images over insecure transmission channels, a new image encryption algorithm Noise-Crypt is proposed in this paper. Noise-Crypt integrates nonlinear random noise, hybrid chaotic maps, and SHA-256 hashing algorithm. The utilized hybrid chaotic maps are the logistic-tent and the logistic-sine-cosine map. The hybrid chaotic maps enhance the pseudorandom sequence generation and selection of substitution boxes, while the logistic-sine-cosine map induces non-linearity in the algorithm through random noise. This deliberate inclusion of noise contributes to increased resistance against cryptanalysis. The proposed scheme has been evaluated for several security parameters, such as differential attacks, entropy, correlation, etc. Extensive evaluation demonstrates the efficacy of the proposed scheme, with almost ideal values of entropy of 7.99 and correlation of −0.0040. Results of the security analysis validate the potency of the proposed scheme in achieving robust image encryption.

articleTitle: FEM Based Air-Core Reactor Modelling for Series Inductor of SPRFCL
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: The increment of fault currents is a serious problem for power systems. Fault current limiters (FCL) are proposed as a solution to alleviate the effects of high fault currents to system components. Solid-state fault current limiters (SSFCL) are effective to limit fault currents as a controlled and fast-response devices. Topological approaches are generally made for SSFCLs, however, there are not enough studies on design and performance analysis of equipment for high voltage applications. In this study, the physical design of an air-core reactor that will be an inductor of series-parallel resonance-type fault current limiter (SPRFCL) is handled for a test system of 20 kV. The air-core reactor model is constituted via COMSOL Multiphysics which involves an electrical circuit coupled with a Finite Element Method (FEM) based design. After expected inductance value of reactor achieved, the electrical simulations are made. The results of fault current and magnetic flux density values of air-core reactor are obtained from COMSOL Multiphysics. In order to validate the operation of the air-core reactor, the same power system was modeled in PSCAD and the results were found to be compatible for the same fault scenarios.

articleTitle: An Improved CNN-Based Pooling Algorithm for Medical Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a common and potentially vision-threatening complication of diabetes. Accurate and timely detection of DR is crucial for effectively managing and preventing vision loss. In this study, we propose a novel methodology for DR detection using multi-modal retinal imaging and deep learning techniques. The methodology incorporates a convolutional neural network (CNN) model with an integrated algorithm for image fusion, leveraging the unique characteristics of different imaging modalities. A comprehensive dataset of retinal images, including fundus photographs, optical coherence tomography (OCT) scans, and fluorescein angiography images, was utilized for training and evaluation. The performance of the proposed methodology was assessed using metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. Our results demonstrate an accuracy of 92%, with a sensitivity of 88% and specificity of 94%. Additionally, the calculated F1 score of approximately 0.878 reflects the balanced performance of the model in terms of precision and recall. These findings highlight the potential of our methodology for accurate and reliable DR detection, offering a valuable tool for healthcare professionals in diagnosing and managing this sight-threatening condition.

articleTitle: Tabular Dyna-Q Algorithm for Online Calculation of LQR Gains: A Simulation Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for the online calculation of Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) gains using the Tabular Dyna-Q algorithm. By leveraging Q-learning, this technique enables the determination of gains for unknown dynamic systems by using input-output data only. The proposed algorithm is particularly advantageous for situations where acquiring input-output data is expensive or time-consuming, as it effectively reduces computation time by reusing previous data. To validate the accuracy of the calculations and control scheme, a simulation example is provided. The results indicate the effectiveness of the Tabular Dyna-Q algorithm in accurately computing LQR gains and its potential application in real-world scenarios. This research contributes to advancing the field of control theory by offering an efficient and reliable method for online gain calculation in dynamic systems.

articleTitle: Control Law and Experimental Results Forthe Switched Reluctance Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Electromagnetic machines have a number of outstanding advantages such as simple structure (there is no winding wire in the rotor so it is easy to cool, no electrical contact between the brush and the commutator), high efficiency, and the rotor's inertia is small. Stable structure suitable for machines with high rotational speed, large starting torque and good short-term overload, reliable operation. This paper presents a method of controlling output parameters of reactive electromagnetic machines in general and controlling output power of reactive electromagnetic generators in particular. Optimization of phase control parameters in single pulse mode of 550 kW reactive electromagnetic machine and determination of control law for motor-generator system through experimental process. Adjust the output power PG by shifting the short-circuit angle <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\gamma ({U_f} = 0)$</tex> forward (to the left) when the closing angle position <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\alpha _{on}}$</tex> and the cut-off angle <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\alpha _{\text{off}}}$</tex> have a wider adjustment range. When shifting the closing angle <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${\alpha _{on}}$</tex> to the rear, this case is used when it is necessary to adjust the limit of the current or to adjust the PWM voltage pulse. The single pulse control method optimizes the torque value of the SRM when working in rated mode [11].

articleTitle: Novel Low Power System Design for Aviation Industrial Data Logger
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This paper is intended to describe the design process, planning, and development of a new Data Logger System (DLS) that can be potentially used in acquiring sensor signals in the landing gear of aircraft. The developed data logger system is capable of simultaneously recording 32 channels of incoming data provided by conditioned sensors. The data recorder system is meant to be an integrated tool to supplement landing gear studies at Safran Landing Systems. The main module of the product will house the vital DLS electronics which include, but are not limited to, a data logger system control board, power management system, and sensors/data interfaces. The developed work presents the concept and development process of the DLS that employs a novel low-power pulse mode circuit structure. It outlines the overview of the sensor acquisition system and manufacturing of the DLS housing to fit the industrial partner's requirements. The conducted work is broken down into several phases, these include conceptual design, development, production, and testing.

articleTitle: Learning Analytics to Validate Academic Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: The learning process is increasingly on the agenda. As well as the mechanisms that can be used to optimize it, both in terms of improving student performance, as well as improving teacher performance. On this subject, there has been continuous research, and increasingly trying to take advantage of technological development, and thus be able to take full advantage of technology and achieve a significant leverage in this field. This work is developed within the scope of the evaluation of school performance. Namely, with the introduction of additional and customized resources, such as thematic courses on the Coursera platform, and the utilization analysis of the e-learning platform used by the teaching institution. With this, it was possible to develop some tools, which are used as dashboards to give the teacher a greater perception of the student's learning process and performance. And if any student is in the prospect of failing, the teacher receives an immediate notification, so that he can carry out the respective follow-up, and thus be able to act proactively to avoid failure.

articleTitle: A Model-Based PID Control of Turning Maneuver for Catamaran Autonomous Surface Vessel
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: The effective automatic control of aerial, water, and ground autonomous vehicles become one of the high-priority tasks in the areas of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), Industry 4.0, and the world economy in general. Besides extensive research on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), the study of Autonomous Surface Vessels (ASVs) has been more than 10 times less intensive. The paper discusses the control mathematics of a realistic ASV nonlinear model of the real autonomous boat “Nymo” developed at the Tallinn University of Technology. The paper offers and simulates in Simulink/MATLAB environment a specially designed control system using a PID controller. The control for the desired tracking has been presented for such maneuvers as the turn of the catamaran at different angles. The proposed control system showed good performance in tracking the desired heading angles.

articleTitle: Development of Rectifier Performance Using Harmonic Balance Simulation for RF Energy Harvester Prototype
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: As the demand for Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology and Internet of Things (lOT) continue to grow, there is an increasing demand for sustainable and autonomous power solutions to energize low powered devices. Thus, the dependency on battery should be mitigated for a passive operation. This paper explores the concept of rectenna architecture-based radio frequency energy harvesters specifically designed for low power RFID application. The prototype harvests the abundance of Wi-Fi signals at frequency band of 2.4 GHz. A seven stages Cockroft-Walton rectifier with Schottky diode from HSMS286C and MA4E2054BI-1146T and low pass filter is designed. Initial Advance Design System (ADS) simulation results shows that 3.53 V can be harvested with 1.57 mm Rogers 5880 printed circuit board (PCB) substrate thickness under minimum power input of −10 dBm (0.1 mW). The results present the feasibility delivering a constant voltage of 1.5 V below −10 dBm to power a small device.

articleTitle: Characterization of a Zinc Oxide Coated Polymer Optical Fiber for Limonene Concentration Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This study evaluates the potential of evanescent wave sensing as a non-invasive technique for limonene concentration characterization, which is one of the biomarkers for liver disease detection. The project proposes the development of a fiber optic sensor as an alternative to the bio-sensing applications for limonene characterization. Chemical etching was employed to remove the cladding from the plastic optical fiber (POF) for the sensor probe design, and zinc oxide (ZnO) was coated onto the POF's core as an enhanced sensing material. An experimental setup was built to measure the output voltage from the POF sensor when the limonene concentration and refractive index were altered. The diameter of the POF sensing probe was fixed at 0, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, and 0.70 mm, with a fiber length of 10 cm and an unclad length for the sensing probe of 2 cm. The results show that the output voltage decreases as the limonene concentration increases, and a smaller tapered waist diameter of the POF produces higher voltages. The coated POF sensor also has higher sensitivity than an uncoated sensor. Therefore, the ZnO coated POF sensor can be a potential low-cost and simple sensing device for limonene concentration measurement. The highest sensitivity was recorded at 0.45 mm tapered POF which is 4.026 V/RIU with a linearity of 98.76% and the slope shows good linearity of more than 99%. Additionally, it was shown that coating the sensing probe with ZnO increased the sensor sensitivity by more than 50% in comparison to the uncoated POF.

articleTitle: Meta Social Network - Concept, Empirical Validation and Feasibility
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: In this paper, the authors present the concept of a meta-social network, as an abstraction layer between different social networks, capable of providing information and opportu-nities that the direct use of social networks does not allow. The concept is defined as an ontology that describes the relationship of the users, their entities in social networks, and the relationships they have in each of these networks, according to their semantics (friend, works, …). In the paper, the authors specify the ontology using Protege and, present application examples describing their practical potential. The authors also discuss the problems and challenges that need to be resolved for its implementation.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Complex $\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}}$-C Filter with one Type of $\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}}$ Cell
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: In this paper, a technique to implement a complex <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{g}_{\mathrm{m}}$</tex>-C filter using “one type of gm cell” is presented. This technique simplifies the design and layout, and improves component matching which is important to achieve higher image rejection (IR). By using the introduced technique, the drop in IR due to mismatch of the coupling <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$g_{m}$</tex> cells will be reduced. All the needed <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$g_{m}$</tex> cells in the main filter and coupling paths will be an integer multiplication of a unit <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$g_{m}$</tex> cell. This simple and methodical approach can be combined with the post-layout parasitic adjustment for a simpler and more efficient design procedure.

articleTitle: IoT WSN MAC Protocol: Simulation Analysis of Minimum Packets in Queue Nodes for Medium Access Contention
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This paper analyzes the performance of the PSA-MAC (Priority Sink Access-MAC) protocol, specifically when using the packet aggregation transmission mode (APT). In APT mode, frames that group several packets are transmitted, making the transmission process more efficient. On the other hand, in PSA-MAC, the nodes are activated and contend for the medium when at least one packet has arrived in their queue. This can cause the APT mode not to be used to its full potential since the nodes can attempt to transmit even if they have not completed the number of packets queued, according to the APT configuration. The introduction of a mechanism that allows the variation of the minimum number of queued packets for node activation is proposed. With this mechanism, queue nodes must wait for more packets to achieve their activation. The study has been carried out by means of a discrete event simulator developed in C to imitate the WSN scenario. Average power consumption, average packet delay, and packet loss probability have been considered as performance parameters. Energy savings results of up to 30% are observed due to the incorporation of this mechanism. However, in terms of packet delay, the performance may deteriorate for low traffic loads.

articleTitle: Slot Antenna Array with Compact Feed based on a Substrate Integrated Fabry-Perot Cavity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: This work presents a new technique for designing the feeding circuit of a slot antenna array. The radiating slots are arrayed on one side of a single layer printed circuit board. The array is excited via a compact substrate integrated Fabry-Perot cavity (FPC). At the resonance of the cavity, the outgoing field is quasi-uniform and permits a transverse electromagnetic traveling-wave mode through the array at 8 GHz frequency. The FPC is fed by a microstrip line using a transition made of a metallic via and a coplanar-waveguide (CPW) line. Based on this design principle, the array is optimized. This design offers a simplified and smaller feeding circuit than conventional antennas that use multiple dividers or combiners. Simulated results validate the proposed approach. These results illustrate acceptable impedance matching, and an 18 dB gain. This technique demonstrates a feasibility step in antenna engineering.

articleTitle: Hardware Design of Skin Cancer Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Engineering and Emerging Technologies (ICEET)
abstract: Skin cancer is one of the most commonly diagnosed cancers worldwide. Early detection is crucial to improving the chances of recovery. In last few years, technology has made advancements in early cancer detection efforts. Technology-based cancer detection devices have been developed to diagnose cancer with precise accuracy. One important aspect of a skin cancer detection device is the hardware design. This research will focus on the development of hardware solutions and innovations to address the shortcomings of existing devices, thereby improving efficiency and ease of examination. In the initial of the design process, a 3D print design is created using software. Afterwards, the internal components such as a microcomputer, camera, UPS, battery and screen are integrated, connected using various cables. Then, the integrated components are combined with the 3D-printed body. Tests are conducted including battery endurance, measurements of the 3D-printed design, screen functionality testing and webcam camera testing for image capture.
